candidates.description: This feature vector activates strongly on prefixes and sub-word tokens belonging to various Indic scripts and Arabic alphabets.
This feature vector represents common Hindi consonant-vowel conjuncts and morphological suffixes.
This feature vector activates on common sub-word tokens and individual characters across various non-Latin scripts.
These tokens represent common Hindi vowel sign suffixes combined with punctuation marks.
This vector is related to common Devanagari (Hindi) root words and prefixes.
This vector activates for common Hindi vowel matras, dependent vowel signs, and consonant-vowel combinations in the Devanagari script.
This vector is related to Hindi and Indo-Aryan script characters and subword tokens.
This vector activates for Devanagari retroflex consonants and related character combinations.
This feature vector activates on common Hindi subword units and character sequences.
These tokens represent the Hindi vowel sign 'ै' (ai) and its combination variants with various consonants and anusvara in the Devanagari script.
